Pending changes

Nothing here has changed the draft yet. Apply term edits and classification changes separately, or export the term edits as a change-set CSV. Once applied they move into Review changes.

Classifications

Term types, focus areas and sources are governed lists. Values on terms are checked against them exactly, apart from surrounding whitespace. Renaming a value rewrites it on every term that uses it.

Import a change-set

A change-set is a CSV of add, update and remove rows with the Action column filled. Rows are checked against the glossary and the classifications, then staged for review — nothing is applied on import.

Drop a change-set CSV here, or

Versions

Published versions. The change-set lists what altered in that release; the full glossary is fetched from the repository as it stood at that version, so it is the file exactly as published rather than today's rebuilt from memory.

Use this only if the glossary is being reconciled against a file produced elsewhere. It replaces both the draft and the published baseline.

Rename value

Renaming rewrites this value everywhere it is used — across the master list and any staged edits — so nothing is left pointing at the old spelling.

Connect to the repository

This only needs doing once on this machine. The access token is kept in this browser and is never sent anywhere except GitHub.

Recorded on every change so the history says who made it. The access token belongs to the account rather than the person, so without this every entry looks identical no matter who is facilitating.
For example GitMISMO/glossary.
A fine-grained token scoped to this one repository, with Contents: read and write. Anyone who can use this browser profile can publish, so treat the machine accordingly.
